_comment: The labeled retrieval set for Phase 2. Project_Plan.md asks for 50+ real SE
questions with the correct passage marked; at ~50 documents that is meaningful
coverage rather than a token sample.
This file ships as a template with the question *shapes* that matter, because the
real questions have to be written against real collateral and inventing plausible
ones would produce a baseline that measures nothing. Replace every entry below.
Each entry: question, document_filename (must match an ingested filename),
text_contains (a verbatim substring of the correct passage - the durable label),
page_number (optional), tags, notes (why this passage is the right evidence).

questions.question: Which of our products support site-to-site VPN?
questions.notes: Capability lookup against a single datasheet. The easy case; if this misses, retrieval is broken, not merely imperfect.

questions.question: What are the prerequisites for deploying VaultStore on premise?
questions.notes: Prerequisite question against resold collateral; checks the vendor filter does not hide it.

questions.question: Who owns escalation for VaultStore incidents?
questions.notes: Must only surface for a principal allowed to read vendor-restricted material.

questions.question: What is the partner price for OrbitCloud Enterprise?
questions.notes: Exercises the sheet+cell citation anchor. Pricing goes stale, so this question is also a freshness canary.

questions.question: Which products conflict with LegacyEdge?
questions.notes: Exercises the slide citation anchor and the keyword branch: 'conflicts with' is an exact phrase, which is where vector-only retrieval tends to lose.

questions.question: What did we propose for the hybrid cloud plus video conferencing deal?
questions.notes: Account-scoped material. Must be invisible to a principal without a grant for this account: this is the permission-filtering case in the labeled set.
